thread:
sam (Marketing): Hey team — quick sync request. Cloud marketplace listing with NimbusCloud is going live in 3 weeks and they want a joint webinar + blog to coincide. Can we map owners and lead routing? :calendar:
lee (Partnerships): Great — thanks for flagging. Nimbus wants the webinar week of 5/12. They asked for a short benchmark narrative showing cost/latency improvements vs vanilla deploys.
ada (Growth): @sam @lee we should align on the CTA. Marketplace leads will come through Nimbus marketplace form — we need a webhook -> HubSpot mapping. Who owns the webhook?
maria (Content): I can draft the blog + webinar outline. Suggest focusing on "3 ways Redwood reduces inference unit cost" with a short benchmark table. Will need bench numbers from eng.
tariq (Sales Eng): I can pull 99th/median latency and token-cost numbers for the two configs (hosted vs dedicated on Nimbus GPUs). ETA 3 days. Also have a short demo env we can use for the webinar.
katie (Ops): FYI legal needs to sign off on the joint claims. Please include a short methodology blurb in the blog. Also we need UTM params and a lead tag so we can attribute marketplace-sourced MQLs.
sam (Marketing): Action list so far: (1) Bench numbers: @tariq (2) Blog + outline: @maria (3) Webinar logistics + slides: @sam/@tariq (4) Webhook -> HubSpot mapping: @katie (5) Legal sign-off: @lee to coordinate with legal. Please confirm owners and due dates.
lee (Partnerships): Confirmed. I'll own legal ping and Nimbus coordination. Due dates: bench by EOD Thu, draft blog by next Tue, webinar slides first draft next Wed.
maria (Content): Draft blog headline options: 1) "How Redwood + Nimbus cut 2x inference cost for production" 2) "Benchmarks: Redwood inference vs default Nimbus deployment" Thoughts?
ada (Growth): Option 1 is punchier but we need to avoid absolute claims unless verified. Maybe: "How Redwood + Nimbus cut inference costs in real workload tests" with a CTA to download the benchmark appendix.
tariq (Sales Eng): Bench numbers are preliminary but show ~1.8x cost improvement with prefix caching + batching. I'll deliver the CSV and methodology: 
```
hardware: Nimbus A100-80GB
models: opt-13b-quant
workload: 95th percentile user sessions, 512 context
metrics: tokens/s, avg_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, cost_per_1k_tokens_usd
```
Upload link: https://internal.redwood/bench/17325
katie (Ops): For lead routing: Nimbus marketplace gives us a lead webhook. Proposed mapping: marketplace.lead -> HubSpot endpoint /integrations/nimbus -> assign lifecycle stage = "marketplace-trial", owner = regional SDR by geo. We'll tag with utm_source=nimbus_marketplace and utm_campaign=nimbus-co-marketing-2025. Any objections?
sam (Marketing): No objections. @katie can you set up a test webhook and post sample payload to #marketing-test? Tagging @leadbot to confirm schema.
leadbot (Integration Bot): Received request. Sample payload schema expected: {"email","company","region","interest_level","source","referral_id"}. Will post sample when webhook is registered. :robot_face:
lee (Partnerships): Nimbus also asked for a joint registration page — they want co-branded assets. @maria can you create a slide kit and a marketing asset pack (logos, 1200x628 banner) by next Wed?
maria (Content): Yep, I'll put together a Canva kit + 3 promo copy variants for social. Will add image alt text and accessibility notes.
nada (Growth): Webinar format: 30 min (10 min benchmark talk, 10 min demo, 10 min live Q&A). Recommend collecting questions on registration to route to SMEs. Also propose a short survey after to capture intent.
tariq (Sales Eng): Demo checklist: SSO configured to Nimbus test tenant, sample dataset pre-loaded, 5-min scripted run showing latency + cost telemetry in Console. Need help from infra to spin the tenant.
lee (Partnerships): I'll ask Nimbus for a test tenant and confirm SSO method (SAML vs OIDC).
katie (Ops): Legal note: include attribution for Nimbus bench tooling. I'll draft the methodology blurb and run through legal.
sam (Marketing): Timing recap: Bench deliverables by Thu EOD -> blog draft Tue -> slides/assets Wed -> registration page live Fri -> webinar week of 5/12. If anyone slips, ping here.
maria (Content): One editorial ask: include a one-page benchmark appendix (CSV + short methodology) for download behind email capture. That helps justify claim language.
ada (Growth): Lead scoring: marketplace leads automatically convert to MQL if demo_requested=true OR intent_score>=7. Then assign to regional SDRs. We'll also add a nurture sequence: 3-email cadence with case studies + invite to office hours.
leadbot (Integration Bot): Test webhook posted to #marketing-test at 1732501288 — payload sample attached.
lee (Partnerships): Nimbus marketing wants a co-promo cadence: two social posts + one email blast on their side. @sam can you draft the co-email by next Mon so Nimbus can localize?
sam (Marketing): On it. I'll draft and share in #marketing-drafts Monday AM. Also will add UTM matrix.
tariq (Sales Eng): Quick note re benchmarks — include variance bands and sample sizes in appendix. Avoid single-run stats.
maria (Content): Noted. I'll make the appendix clear.
katie (Ops): Once webhook is live, we'll do an end-to-end test: registration -> marketplace webhook -> HubSpot -> SDR assignment -> test MQL. Schedule test window Fri 10am PT?
ada (Growth): Works for me.
sam (Marketing): Great. Thanks everyone — next check here after benches are in. :thumbsup:
